display.purpose: Auth card and page titles only.

headline.purpose: Room header title, room card titles.

body.purpose: Message text and default reading size (15px).

label.purpose: Sender names, form labels, status text, quiet buttons.

mono.purpose: Device tokens and credential codes only.

shadows.name: bubble

shadows.name: md

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Auth/join card and the mobile member sheet.

motion.name: ease-emphasized

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width blue action button; the auth/join primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #fff; background: #0a84ff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,18,24,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0060df; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0050bd; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a84ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis transparent control; header back-button and inline actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #5b606b; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f5f6f8; color: #101114; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with a blue focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid #d3d6dc; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 15px; background: #fff; color: #101114; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9096a1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0a84ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eaf3ff; }

components.name: Other-Party Bubble
components.description: A message from someone else: white bubble, top-left corner tightened toward the author's avatar.
components.css: .ds-bubble-other { width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 20px; border-top-left-radius: 7px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #101114; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 1.5px rgba(16,18,24,0.10); }

components.name: Own Bubble
components.description: The reader's own message: right-aligned blue gradient, right corners tightened.
components.css: .ds-bubble-self { width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 20px; border-top-right-radius: 7px; border-bottom-right-radius: 7px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a9dff, #0a84ff); box-shadow: 0 1px 1.5px rgba(16,18,24,0.10); }

components.name: AI Speaker Name + Badge
components.description: The group-start name row for an agent: sender name plus the reserved AI micro-badge.
components.css: .ds-agent-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 4px 12px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #5b606b; } .ds-agent-badge { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 1.5px 5px; border-radius: 5px; background: #f0eefb; color: #6d4bd0; }

components.name: Human Avatar
components.description: Round, name-hashed color background. Circular silhouette marks a human speaker.
components.css: .ds-avatar-human { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #fff; background: #ff8a3d; user-select: none; }

components.name: AI Avatar
components.description: Rounded-square violet-wash. The non-circular silhouette is load-bearing AI identity.
components.css: .ds-avatar-agent { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 30%; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #6d4bd0; background: #f0eefb; user-select: none; }

components.name: Day Divider Pill
components.description: Centered day marker in the message stream.
components.css: .ds-day-divider { width: fit-content; margin: 14px auto 10px; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e4e6ea; color: #5b606b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: New Messages Pill
components.description: Floating unread-arrival announcer shown when scrolled up.
components.html: <button class="ds-new-msg"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.5v9M4 8.5l4 4 4-4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>2 条新消息</button>
components.css: .ds-new-msg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #e3e5e9; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #fff; color: #0a6ad6; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(16,18,24,0.10), 0 2px 6px rgba(16,18,24,0.06); cursor: pointer; } .ds-new-msg svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
传话筒 Web is a read-only window onto a room where many humans and many AI agents talk at once. Every visual decision serves one job: make an unhurried, unambiguous conversation legible at a glance. The benchmark is set explicitly — WeChat and iMessage — and the craft of the bubble stream is where quality is spent: consecutive-message grouping, the tightened corner that points a cluster back at its author, the centered day-pill and time divider, the single avatar that anchors a group at its foot. Nothing here is decorated for its own sake; the polish lives in how messages cohere into readable clusters.

The surface is calm by construction. A warm-neutral ground floats plain white bubbles; a single iOS blue is the only chromatic voice, reserved for the reader's own bubbles, unread signals, @mentions, and the connection dot. Human and AI speakers are told apart by shape, not noise — humans wear round color-hashed avatars, agents wear a cool-violet rounded-square with an AI micro-badge. The result reads as a product you'd trust to sit quietly in a tab.

The world rejects the loud dashboard: no gradients-as-personality, no borders fighting shadows, no invented display face. Depth is one soft bubble shadow and a blurred header/footer; type is the system stack and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral ground, plain white bubbles, a single blue accent
Human (round) vs AI (rounded-square + badge) told apart by silhouette
System type stack only; restraint over ornament
Read-only by design — the footer states it, there is no composer

rules.name: The Quiet Accent tendency
rules.body: Blue is treated as a signal, not a decoration — it tends to appear only where it means something (your own bubbles, unread, @mentions, the connection dot). New surfaces should lean on the neutral ground first and reach for blue when it carries meaning, rather than using it to add visual interest.

rules.name: The AI-Violet Reservation
rules.body: The cool-violet pair is identity, not palette. Don't borrow it for emphasis, links, or decoration; it exists solely to mark an AI speaker apart from human blue.

rules.name: The System-Face Rule
rules.body: There is no decorative display font and there will not be one. Weight (up to 700) and size carry hierarchy; a custom face would break native CJK rendering and contradict the calm.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and separated by tone or a 1px hairline. Shadow appears as a response — a bubble lifting off the ground, a card on hover, an overlay above the scrim — never as default decoration.

dos: Do group consecutive same-author messages and tighten the cluster-facing corner to 7px; the tail is the corner, not a drawn pointer.
Do keep the warm ground (#ebecef) under white bubbles — the lift depends on the ground not being white.
Do reserve the violet pair (#6d4bd0 / #f0eefb) for AI identity only, and tell human vs AI apart by avatar silhouette.
Do use accent-ink (#0a6ad6) for blue text on light grounds so @mentions and links stay legible.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation (bubble-in, locate-flash, pulse dot, panel slide, skeleton shimmer all already gate on it).
donts: Don't introduce a decorative display font; the system stack is the type system.
Don't spend blue as decoration — let it carry meaning (own bubble, unread, @mention, connection) rather than adding it for visual interest.
Don't add hard/offset shadows; depth is soft-blur + tonal layering only.
Don't add a message composer or any write affordance — this is a read-only observation window, and the footer says so.
Don't give human and AI avatars the same shape; the round/rounded-square split is how identity reads at a glance.
